rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something fair, justifiable, within limits, or fairly priced.

example.jyutping: ne1 go3 gaai2 sik1 hou2 hap6 lei5

rows.note: Use this when the point is that a price is not high, rather than that it is fair or justified.

example.english: This shirt isn't expensive, so it's reasonable to buy it.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 m4 gwai3 maai5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for work or results that are satisfactory or acceptable but not outstanding.

example.english: This report is reasonable as it is.
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 gam3 joeng2 dou1 gwo3 dak1 heoi3
